setting: The chamber floor glows only on tiles 19 and 23. The pendulum hangs motionless, its blue tip still hovering over 23. A grinding sound begins from the far wall where the number 23 is etched.
action: Leo, still standing on tile 23, feels the vibration through his shoes. He looks at Zara, who watches the wall with wide eyes. A seam of golden light appears in the stone, widening into a doorway.
learning_moment: The successful application of the arithmetic progression (3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23 with constant difference 4) directly causes the payoff—the door opening—reinforcing that pattern recognition solves real problems.
transition_hint: The doorway grinds fully open, revealing a dark corridor beyond. But instead of freedom, a new glowing sequence appears on the corridor floor: 2, 5, 8, 11...
narrator_audio_text: Stone ground against stone as a hidden door swung inward. Golden light spilled from the new opening, illuminating their hopeful faces.

student_interaction.prompt_text: A new sequence appears: 2, 5, 8, 11... If this is also an arithmetic progression, what is the constant difference?
student_interaction.reveal_text: 3. 5 - 2 = 3, 8 - 5 = 3, 11 - 8 = 3. The pattern continues with the same step each time.
